meta.name: incoming-request-advisor
meta.description: Decode an incoming message into a structured breakdown separating the literal ask from the job-to-be-done. Use when a loaded Slack ping, email, mandate, or escalation needs a reply.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把收到的消息拆解成字面请求与真实任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常为含糊的请求而难以回复
copy.tagline_en: Break down incoming requests into surface asks and real tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to clarify ambiguous requests before replying

howto.what: 收到消息后先拆解成结构化分析:把字面要求与背后的真实目标分开,判断发件人权力与利害关系,再输出包含假设清单的分段报告。
howto.when: 当需要回复一条带情绪的 Slack 消息、邮件或指令(含升级投诉)时触发;任何让你想照字面立即回复的消息也会触发。

say.text: 我 VP 刚私信我:'看板改版能排进下个迭代吗?董事会问起。' 先帮我拆解一下。
say.note: 它会输出分层拆解和待验证假设。

say.text: 收到一封客户成功负责人的升级投诉邮件,帮我分析字面要求和背后的真实诉求。
say.note: 它会识别发件人立场并给回复选项。

howto.what_en: Decodes an incoming message into a structured breakdown: separates the literal ask from the job-to-be-done, assesses sender power/stake, and outputs a sectioned analysis with an assumptions list.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a loaded Slack ping, email, or mandate (incl. escalations) needs a reply — or any message that invites a literal reply.

say_en.text: I got an escalation email from a CS lead. Analyze the literal ask and the real need behind it.
say_en.note: It identifies sender stance and offers reply options.

say_en.text: This mandate sounds like a build order. I want the job-to-be-done underneath, not a spec.
say_en.note: It separates the ask from the underlying need.
